hypothesis: Greater contextual capacity and assembly-targeted pretraining may improve global membership and deep assembly; neither benefit is established by the frozen-head pilot.
changed_factor: 2x2 factorial: contextual width 128 versus 256 and existing versus assembly-targeted pretraining objectives; hyperbolic width fixed at 32
control: 128-wide existing-objective arm with a comparable pretraining history; identical downstream interface, adaptation schedule and inference policy across all four arms
target_contract: Global unordered optional B membership plus unassigned, relation-specific within-B parent/sibling discrimination and reconstruction from detector-only or generated partial states. Truth is supervision only; do not globally repel legitimate relatives. Any predicted membership/group conditioning is shared across all arms.
data_and_compute_control: Match authenticated training identities, presentations and downstream schedules. Objective arms share initialization within each width; establish comparable histories across widths rather than fresh-256 versus historical-128. Keep depth and hyperbolic geometry fixed. Keep downstream head width common and sufficient for both encoders, or explicitly document an information-preserving interface; do not silently reuse the 64-wide pilot bottleneck. Report parameters, compute, memory and convergence; equal updates are not equal FLOPs.
stop_rule: No automatic jobs, 512-wide model or additional pretraining-duration campaign. Do not scale on training loss or tiny memorization alone. Review the four-arm development contrast before any primary reservation or larger capacity study.
success_rule: Report width and objective contrasts separately plus their interaction. Require count-backed heldout membership gain with background/validity accounting; inspect deep proposal and B-pool recovery. Membership-only gains do not establish hierarchy success. Preserve the tiny raw-membership gate before primary scale-up.
validation_selection: Continuation user authorization explicitly permits fresh NON-PRIMARY development designation from remaining validation. Phase74 designates600 authenticated heldout identities (100/category), excluding all train, historical primary, supplementary, development and checkpoint-selection identities. Fixed final checkpoint and0.5 threshold; no adaptive tuning or primary reservation.
followup_if_negative: Locate representation versus head/optimization or decoder-use failure using train/heldout relation and membership probes; do not conclude that all capacity scaling or pretraining is ineffective.
phase73_terminal_interpretation: Both jobs completed: tiny raw 32/32 each; heldout raw and accepted 0/40 each. Main-train raw 2/256 frozen and 30/256 adapted. No heldout gate passed; sparse main training fit does not establish irrecoverable encoder information loss or data scarcity.
